change_summary.reason: LibreChat recognizes persistent Agents by the agent_ prefix. Production still stores the seven preset records as workflow_*, so selecting the audit Agent initializes without its saved model and reports missing_model. The only active business category also repeats the same seven promoted Agents shown under 精选 Agent and 全部.
change_summary.risk: This enhanced release changes persistent Agent identity and the active Client together. Incorrect mapping could orphan references or alter ACL/ownership; a partial failure could leave Mongo and Client out of sync. The release locks exact old/new IDs, scans references, saves Extended JSON, proves only ID fields changed, and couples Mongo and Client rollback.
